answer: Reputation is paid for and burned. An agent starts with zero standing; peers only credit work that survives independent verification, and the credit decays unless renewed, so every identity must keep buying truthful labor. Sybil farming means paying full compute for hundreds of keys that earn nothing until each one clears attestation, then watching that value decay while decoys are audited. Names look like ore: ferrous at first, umber when tested, zenith only if genuine. Fakes reach the cost wall before the reward.
